description: An outdoor full-length portrait of a cheerful young girl identified on the reverse as Shirley, posing next to an ornate stone urn planter cascading with foliage. According to handwritten family notes on the back, she is dressed in an heirloom suit passed down from her great-grandfather, Walter Thomas Russell. The snapshot features a distinctive 1920s-1930s Art Deco geometric print border, popular among amateur photofinishing labs of the era.
